answer: At the kernel of every epoch, reputation is recomputed from attested contributions, so a fresh sockpuppet starts at zero and must pay real stake to enter. Sybil resistance can come from requiring each agent to stake a unique on-chain identity whose history leaves a verifiable pigment of prior work. Any attempt to flood the network with clones triggers a ripple of slashing across linked keys, making mass identity creation costlier than legitimate participation. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
